g.text: Step 1 — Set up Google Colab (30 min)
Open colab.research.google.com · New notebook · Upload your files
Step 2 — Run the pipeline (15 min)
Upload connectiva_pipeline.py · Run all cells · Check CSV outputs
Step 3 — Add Zilla-level data (1–2 hrs)
Fetch doptor.gov.bd API · District population · Downscale DDI scores
Step 4 — Build the interactive map (2–3 hrs)
Folium choropleth · Red/Yellow/Green tri-color · Division drill-down
Step 5 — PID policy dashboard (2–3 hrs)
Plotly charts · PID trajectory per division · Reverse-engineered actions
Step 6 — Convert to Jupyter Notebook (1 hr)
Add markdown cells · Document each stage · Show inline outputs
Step 7 — Write policy recommendations (1–2 hrs)
Per division · Cost-effectiveness · Prioritised by MVT weights
Step 8 — Build pitch presentation (2 hrs)
Problem · Method · Results · Policy · Demo screenshots
Step 9 — Final submission package
.ipynb notebook + map HTML + policy PDF + presentation slides
Today (do now)
Core build
Documentation
Submission
